day_shape: Parallel US and UK sanctions hit IRGC oil networks and Iranian 'criminal proxies', UK-France announce Strait of Hormuz ministerial with HMS Dragon deploying, Trump calls ceasefire 'on life support', and reports allege UAE struck Lavan Island refinery.

threads.label: US and UK sanctions on Iran
threads.summary: The State Department announced a new round of 'Economic Fury' sanctions targeting an IRGC oil-shipping network and three senior figures, while OFAC published an accompanying SDN designation. The UK Foreign Office separately sanctioned a dozen individuals and entities described as 'criminal proxies' of Iran.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz coalition and diplomacy
threads.summary: The UK MoD announced a UK-France ministerial meeting to advance a multinational Strait of Hormuz mission, with HMS Dragon forward-deploying to the region, and Rubio called Foreign Secretary Cooper to discuss freedom of navigation. Iran's deputy foreign minister Ghareebabadi rejected any UN resolution framing the strait without reference to aggression and Iran's rights.

threads.label: Ceasefire on 'life support'
threads.summary: Trump called the Iranian proposal 'totally unacceptable' and described the ceasefire as on 'life support', with reports that he is seriously considering resuming the war; Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei called the proposal 'reasonable and generous'. Iran International reported hardliners pushing escalation as Tehran rejects US terms.

threads.label: UAE alleged role in strikes on Iran
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported that the UAE secretly carried out strikes on Iranian assets, including the Lavan Island refinery in early April. A Jerusalem Post opinion piece characterised the UAE State Security Service as having taken down an Iranian Velayat-e Faqih 'sleeper cell'.

threads.label: Iran internal repression and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported that eight female political prisoners in Evin have been barred from family and lawyer visits, and that more than 70 days of internet restrictions continue to affect daily life. Iran executed a man accused of spying for Mossad and the CIA, and Defa Press reported the hanging of an Ansar al-Furqan member.

threads.label: October 7 sexual violence report
threads.summary: Cochav Elkayam-Levy released a 300-page 'Silenced No More' report documenting what it describes as systematic and strategic sexual violence by Hamas during the October 7 attack. Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post carried multiple items on the findings, including a Jerusalem Post editorial calling for accountability.

threads.label: Khamenei and regime mobilisation messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages on prayer for victory over the enemy and promoted the 'First: Martyrs' Families' campaign with bank details for donations to war-affected Iranians. IRIB and Defa Press carried Pezeshkian remarks on protecting livelihoods, framings of a 'Third Imposed War' and claims that Israel admits inability against Hezbollah drones and recorded 8,683 wounded.

events.title_en: Zionists admit inability against Hezbollah drones
events.summary_en: Zionists admit inability against Hezbollah drones. The newspaper Haaretz from the occupied territories reported that a high-ranking official of the Zionist regime in the reserve system of the ground forces of this regime's army on the northern front [of occupied Palestine] admitted that there is no technological solution to counter drones that are guided by optical fibre. He told the newspaper that pushing Hezbollah back towards the north [of Israel] is also futile, because these drones have the capability to fire and be directed up to a distance of 60 kilometres. Channel 12 of Israel also yesterday acknowledged in a report: the army describes explosive-carrying drones as Hezbollah's central weapon.

events.title_en: Head of the Judiciary: If the white line and internet pro are the correct matter let us explain it; if it is a violation the legal action must be taken
events.summary_en: Head of the Judiciary: If the white line and internet pro are the correct matter let us explain it; if it is a violation the legal action must be taken. Mohseni Ezzehei: We in the judiciary are guardians of the public rights of the people and will by no means allow the feeling to be created in the people that discrimination prevails in our society. The issue known as white lines and internet pro has created a problem in people's minds; this mentality did not arise overnight and if we do not clarify it to the people, it will create conditions for citizens' distrust. We have repeatedly stated that no one should think that because war conditions exist and special exigencies prevail, one can circumvent the law or act contrary to law and religion.

events.title_en: Two batches of Chinese trains ready to enter the country
events.summary_en: Two batches of Chinese trains ready to enter the country. Seyed Mohammad Aghamiri, head of the construction committee of Tehran's Islamic City Council, stated: Imported metro carriages from China are ready for delivery but due to some issues, their transport towards Iran has been delayed. Two batches of trains were supposed to be ready before the end of 1404, but due to maritime conditions in the southern part of the country, their transport has been suspended. As soon as conditions ease in the south of the country, the transport of these two batches from China will take place and 40 days after that they will reach Iran. The Third Imposed War against Iran is not merely a limited military confrontation, but rather a broad clash between the front of arrogance and the Islamic Revolution; a battle in which the military sphere, the presence of people in the streets and diplomacy form three complementary sides of a single strategy. The most important necessity today is to maintain internal cohesion and avoid fanning marginal differences. Experience from major wars has shown that many defeats have occurred not on the battlefield but as a result of the erosion of internal unity.

events.summary_en: Victory over the enemy through the prayer of Imam Zaman (may God hasten his return). Addressing our Master, may God hasten his glorious return, I present that we, with faith in Almighty God and seeking the intercession of the Infallible Imams, may God's prayers and peace be upon them, and following our martyred leader beneath your banner and in the face of the front of disbelief and arrogance, have stood firm, and in this path precious martyrs from various sectors have sacrificed themselves for the honour and independence of the country and the elevation of Islam and the Islamic Revolution, and we have suffered other losses as well. Now with all our being we have set our hearts on the special prayer of Your Excellency for a decisive victory over the enemy both in the arena of negotiations and on the battlefield, and we hope that very soon both we and our enemies will witness the miraculous effect of that.

All property and interests in property subject to U.S. jurisdiction of these persons are blocked, and U.S. persons are generally prohibited from engaging in transactions with them. The vessels placed on the SDN List have been identified as property in which a blocked person has an interest.
